meta.title: The First American Flag — Set 1
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Comprehension on the history, stars, stripes, and makers of the American flag.

questions.question: What colors are on the American flag?
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Our flag is red, white, and blue. It has stars and stripes.'

questions.question: The American flag has always looked exactly the same as it does today.
questions.explanation: False. The text states: 'But did you know that the American flag has not always looked the same?'

questions.question: How many states were in the country when the first flag was made?
questions.explanation: The text says: 'Back then, there were only 13 states. The first flag had a star and a stripe for each state.'

questions.question: Some people think that Betsy Ross, a seamstress in Philadelphia, made the first flag.
questions.explanation: True. The text mentions: 'Some people think it was a seamstress who lived in Philadelphia. Her name was Betsy Ross.'

questions.question: How many stars and stripes did the very first American flag have?
questions.explanation: The text states: 'The first flag had 13 stars and 13 stripes, like this one.'

questions.question: Over the years, as new states joined the country, _______ were added to the blue field.
questions.hint: The white shapes on the blue patch.
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Stars were added to the blue field' as new states joined.

questions.question: The stars on old flags were always arranged in straight rows, never in a circle.
questions.explanation: False. The text states: 'Sometimes the stars were in a circle. Other times they were in rows.'

questions.question: Sort these flags based on whether they had 13 Stripes or 15 Stripes according to the text:
questions.explanation: The first flag, the 1818 flag, and today's flag have 13 stripes. The 1795 flag had 15 stripes before the country decided to return to 13.

questions.question: Hopkinson's flag, which became the first official flag on June 14, 1777, was called the Stars and Stripes.
questions.explanation: True. The text states: 'On June 14, 1777, “Hopkinson’s flag” became the first flag... It was called the Stars and Stripes.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe today's country size:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Our country has fifty states.' There is one star for each state on the flag today.

questions.question: Why did the country go back to having only 13 stripes on the flag in 1818?
options: Adding a new stripe for each state would make stripes too small or the flag too tall
The leaders ran out of red fabric to make stripes
Betsy Ross did not want to sew any more stripes
Some states decided to leave the country
questions.explanation: The text states: 'Adding a new stripe for each new state would mean very small stripes or a very tall flag! So, the country went back to a flag with 13 stripes.'

questions.question: Today's flag got its 50th star on July 4, _______.
questions.explanation: The text states: 'The flag got its 50th star on July 4, 1960.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what Betsy Ross did:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Betsy Ross made the first flag.' Many people believe she was the maker.

questions.question: The 50th star added to the blue field of the flag stands for the state of Hawaii.
questions.explanation: True. The text explains: 'The star stands for the state of Hawaii,' which joined as the 50th state.

questions.question: What is the meaning of the 13 stripes on the flag today?
options: They stand for the first 13 states that started the country
They represent the 13 leaders who designed the flag
They represent 13 months of the year
They are just a decorative pattern with no meaning
questions.explanation: The text states: 'It has 13 stripes, for the first 13 states.' They represent the original 13 colonies.
